review_mode: independent read-only source/pinned-semantics/log review; no builds or source edits
checks: raw_expansion proves exact actual post words=M(actual pre words,actual input span). Typed no-wrap producer is used, and literal REVERT double expansion is reduced using idempotence.
accepted_expansion transports actual Z/dispatcher metadata with unchanged input stack/activeWords, not a proposed poststate.
TraceCharges.cons carries the same actual XStepAt, fuel, gas label, intermediate machine and tail. Every summand is the adjacent actual capacity-cost difference.
of_runs constructs the annotation by induction on the given XRuns and preserves that exact trace/endpoints/fuel. No arbitrary Charges history is an input to from_runs/bounded_from_runs.
telescopes justifies Nat subtraction using actual runtime site closure and capacity monotonicity on each edge; no decrease can be hidden by subtraction truncation.
bounded_from_runs derives total≤cost(final cap)-cost(initial), valid even for nonzero initial capacity, from the actual telescoping equation.

return_expansion inverts actual RETURN Z/StepOk with literal pop2 operands; return_capacity derives the terminal cap from actual access bounds. Terminal charge is not silently included in the nonhalting XRuns annotation.
scope_limits: This computes the source memory-cost formula on actual pinned capacities, not an equation with charges paid by executable Python.
The exact span/M lemma connects each capacity difference to the source-shaped expansion formula; physical reference memory-size relation and checked gas-type transport remain separate.
Final RETURN difference must be appended by the SYSTEM consumer using the same actual terminal witness.
Initial raw runtime resource premises and source-to-formalization boundary remain explicit.
